## Code Review

This pull request implements MHA merge state fusion for MLA attention, allowing direct quantized output for static FP8 quantization during chunked-prefill. The changes include logic to detect fusion support and integrate output scales into the MHA forward pass. Reviewers identified a potential UnboundLocalError due to conditional variable scoping and a risk of bypassing output padding required for CUDA graph compatibility during early returns.

![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

The variable `quant_output` is used in the following block (line 677) when `mha_use_quant_fusion` is true. However, `quant_output` is only defined if `quant_key` is not `None` (line 610). While `mha_merge_state_fusion_supported` currently checks for a specific `quant_key`, this creates a fragile dependency. It is safer to ensure `quant_output` is accessible or that the logic explicitly handles the `None` case to avoid potential `UnboundLocalError` if the fusion support logic changes in the future.

While this is correct for the active tokens, it bypasses the final return of `output_padded` (line 831). ![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

The variable `quant_output` is used in the following block (line 677) when `mha_use_quant_fusion` is true. However, `quant_output` is only defined if `quant_key` is not `None` (line 610). While `mha_merge_state_fusion_supported` currently checks for a specific `quant_key`, this creates a fragile dependency. It is safer to ensure `quant_output` is accessible or that the logic explicitly handles the `None` case to avoid potential `UnboundLocalError` if the fusion support logic changes in the future.

## Code Review

This pull request implements MHA merge state fusion for MLA attention, allowing direct quantized output for static FP8 quantization during chunked-prefill. The changes include logic to detect fusion support and integrate output scales into the MHA forward pass. Reviewers identified a potential UnboundLocalError due to conditional variable scoping and a risk of bypassing output padding required for CUDA graph compatibility during early returns.

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.
